tools.name: get_company_revenue
tools.description: 查已發布公司 JSON 的月營收、月增、年增與累計。金額為千元新台幣；缺漏欄位為 null，不從其他月份補值。

tools.name: compare_industry
tools.description: 以完整產業名稱查同月份公司，依年增率降冪、同值依代號升冪。樣本數為截斷前可排名家數；排除缺營收或年增率者。sort 僅支援 yoy。

tools.name: search_company
tools.description: 依代號或公司名稱做不分大小寫的子字串比對，完整符合優先，其餘依代號升冪，最多回傳 10 筆。

tools.name: get_monthly_revenue_history
tools.description: Monthly revenue history of a Taiwan-listed company from official MOPS filings, with MoM and YoY growth.

tools.name: top_growth
tools.description: Taiwan-listed companies ranked by year-on-year monthly revenue growth, optionally within one industry, from official MOPS filings.
